Academy of Sciences provides 5 FREE Research Labs immediately (massive science boost without production cost), +2 additional Science per Research Lab, -2 Unhappiness from Illiteracy per city (helping offset 43% war weariness), and +100% Production towards future Research Labs. With 6 cities, the free labs alone could add 60-80+ science per turn immediately. Five-Year Plan's production boost is valuable but Academy of Sciences accelerates our science victory timeline more directly. The happiness reduction is critical given our crippling war weariness.

Adjusting persona away from hyper-aggressive conquest posture toward a science-focused, defensively-oriented approach. Reducing WarBias (10→5) and Boldness (10→6) prevents staff from initiating costly offensive operations we cannot sustain. Increasing FriendlyBias (4→7) and DiplomaticBalance (1→5) encourages maintaining Order bloc alliances and seeking diplomatic solutions. Slightly raising WarmongerHate (2→4) to discourage allies from dragging us into conflicts. We still need to defend ourselves but cannot afford aggressive wars.

Improving relationship with The Netherlands from maximum hostility (-100/-100) to reduce barriers to peace negotiations. War weariness at 43% is crippling our economy and development. We cannot capture Amsterdam with our current military (2283 vs 2726), and the stalemate hurts us more than them. The Maya are already crushing the Netherlands in their separate war (71% Dutch war weariness, -28% war score), so Netherlands is being weakened regardless. Making peace would allow us to redirect resources to science development and reduce war weariness penalties. The ideological penalty (-999 Freedom vs Order) still makes friendship impossible, but reduced hostility may enable a ceasefire.
